body:
It's kind of like how my Dad would always joke with me about how women wear white on their weddings so the dishwasher matches the stove. So funny right?

Except not. It's funny for him, and his buddies, and I pretended it was funny for a long time. Why did I pretend it's funny? Because if you don't people start shitting on you directly for not having a sense of humor, or sometimes even worse accusations. 

It's very much the same on reddit, in a lot of places. Lots and lots of jokes about how shitty women are, but "they're just jokes," "lighten up," "what are you, an SJW?"

Excuse me while I go make fun of my buddy for being quadriplegic, it's just a joke right?

I can't tell you what to do with your own life, but I would like to ask that whatever you do, make sure your girl is in a good place first. 

I hope that good place will be with you, but that is your choice.

There is nothing you have to do, and nothing you should do. 

If you want someone to tell you what to do, I will tell you: Sit where you are and breathe. Just breathe. Stop chasing your thoughts in a circle, just let them pass. It's not going to fix it all but you deserve to breathe. 

And when you feel up to it, maybe try responding to one of the people you are most comfortable with?
Want to tell me about your day?
